title: DistilBook: any document into a hand-drawn explainer
summary: A 40 s product promo for a tool that turns documents into drawn explainer videos. A textbook paragraph with pastel highlighter marks dissolves word by word into a hand-drawn water-cycle sketch that draws itself, which then sits inside a video player with karaoke captions; it continues with the same line in 19 narration languages on dark navy, style samples (whiteboard, 3D, 9:16), a '2,194+ videos made' dot-grid stat and a logo end card. Smart demo of input -> output, light HUD frame around everything.
fit_reason: The 'highlighted source text becomes a drawn diagram' and karaoke-under-player moves are great teaching devices for Andrew's 'visual teacher' voice; the sketch style is softer than a premium SaaS brand but works for education content.

palette.mood: light paper white with pastel highlighter marks, blue-ink sketch, navy dark interludes

typography.display: book serif (Georgia/Charter) for source text; bold grotesk (Inter/Söhne bold) for headlines, captions and stats; handwritten marker font for diagram labels
typography.size_behaviour: mixed: huge zoomed serif on opener, mid-size paragraph, bold centred caption under the player (~4% height), big stat numbers
typography.notes: Stacked statements 'Pages. / and pages. / and pages.' with the last line in blue. Tiny HUD text in corners (logo, 'MOTION REEL 2026', bar counter, '144 BPM', timecode) frames every shot.

text_animation: pastel highlighter swipes behind keywords one after another (sun green, ocean blue, vapour pink)
highlighted words lift off the page and fly into the diagram as labels
karaoke caption: grey words turn black, current keyword turns blue
language list scrolls vertically with the centre line sharp and outer lines blurred/faded
captions: karaoke highlight: bold sans centred under the video player, unspoken words light grey, spoken black, keyword blue #4a68e8, no box
motion: rack-focus macro over a textbook page
sketch draws itself stroke by stroke (sun, rays, waves, droplet, cloud)
salt particles scatter out of the sea as dots
player card tilts in 3D then flattens
grid of sample thumbnails zooms out to a dot matrix that forms the stat
transitions: whip/blur slide to dark logo card
graphic_elements: video player chrome with progress bar
ui_treatment: rebuilt UI: simplified script editor ('Evaporation' card with Generate Video button) and a video player frame around the output; HUD overlay throughout

sound.music: electronic beat at 144 BPM (stated in HUD)
sound.voiceover: yes - calm narrator reading the generated script ('The salt stays behind in the sea. The sky only takes the pure water.')
sound.sync: highlights and captions synced to VO; cuts on the 144 BPM grid

signature_moves: pastel highlighter on source text, then those exact words become labels in a drawing
karaoke caption bar under an embedded player
same sentence stacked in many languages with a counter
HUD frame with BPM and timecode on every shot

best_segments.what: Paragraph gets pastel highlights one by one, then words fly into a self-drawing water-cycle sketch
Finished sketch in a player with karaoke caption turning words black/blue
Same line in many languages scrolling on navy with counter ticking to 19

recreate.how: Remotion: highlighter = rect scaleX 0->1 behind span; sketch via SVG stroke-dashoffset on hand-drawn paths (or Excalidraw/rough.js export); karaoke via Whisper word timestamps. HUD as a fixed overlay component.
recreate.prompt: White paper canvas with a serif paragraph; pastel green/blue/pink highlighter swipes behind keywords, then the words fly into a hand-drawn blue-ink diagram that draws itself; the diagram plays inside a player with a bold karaoke caption below (spoken words black, keyword blue #4a68e8); thin HUD corners with timecode; calm narrator.
